title: Concept: debug-exposure error detail disclosed in a response
description: A SQLAlchemy exception trace in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The trace carries the ORM layer, the driver and the failing statement, which is a step-by-step map of the query the endpoint runs.
applicability: Deployments that render a SQLAlchemy exception trace into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The trace carries the ORM layer, the driver and the failing statement, which is a step-by-step map of the query the endpoint runs.
